title: Four-query circuit tester
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n>0$ input bits. Its four-query function tester is the uniform mixture of its quadratic inner-function tester and its four-query input-consistency tester; it has Boolean answers and addresses in the disjoint union of input positions and quadratic PCPP proof positions.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits
caveat: The mixture operation’s exact sampling convention is not defined in the supplied context.
